verdict.rationale: The maintained Smithery CLI says it connects agents to "thousands of skills and MCP servers", and a live public registry still lists third-party servers such as Exa, Context7 and Browserbase. However, Smithery shut down its hosted connection services (API, Connect, Toolbox, managed OAuth) on 2026-10-31, so the catalog is now a non-proxied registry rather than integrations reachable through the hosted platform. Missing for 10: hosted or proxied access to the catalog after the shutdown, managed OAuth for third-party integrations, documented registry API, and independent verification of the catalog's size.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.
